- Exact list of the four behaviors labeled as “trending in the wrong direction” in the CDC report’s *Trend (All Years Available)* section.

- Any official terminology or criteria the CDC used to designate a trend as “wrong direction.”

From the material accessed, it is not possible to provide the requested four areas. Additional targeted access to the official CDC PDF report (e.g., at https://wonder.cdc.gov/yrbs-report-2013-2023.pdf) would be required to locate that specific list.
